questions.prompt:
Complete the 2 × 2 matrix.
Top-left: ○
Top-right: ○ ○
Bottom-left: ●
Bottom-right: ?
Across each row, one identical shape is added. Down each column, open shapes become filled.
questions.explanation: The bottom row must add one filled circle, matching the horizontal count rule and vertical fill change.

questions.prompt:
Complete the 2 × 2 matrix.
Top-left: ↑
Top-right: →
Bottom-left: ↓
Bottom-right: ?
Across each row, the arrow rotates 90° clockwise. Down each column, it rotates 180°.
questions.explanation: Rotating the bottom-left arrow 90° clockwise gives left, while rotating the top-right arrow 180° also gives left.

questions.prompt:
Complete the 2 × 2 matrix.
Top-left: Left ○ | Right □
Top-right: Left □ | Right ○
Bottom-left: Left ● | Right ■
Bottom-right: ?
Across each row, the two shapes exchange positions. Down each column, open shapes become filled.

choices.C: Left ○ | Right □

questions.explanation: Filling the top-right cell gives ■ then ●, and swapping the bottom-left shapes produces the same arrangement.

questions.prompt:
Complete the 3 × 3 matrix.
Row 1: ○ | □ | ○ □
Row 2: △ | ◇ | △ ◇
Row 3: ● | ■ | ?
In each row, the third cell combines the shapes in the first two cells in the same left-to-right order.
questions.explanation: The third cell combines the first and second cells in their original left-to-right order.

questions.prompt:
Complete the 3 × 3 matrix.
Row 1: ○ | ● | ○
Row 2: □ | ■ | □
Row 3: △ | ▲ | ?
In each row, the same shape alternates open, filled, open.
questions.explanation: Each row uses one shape in the pattern open, filled, open.

questions.prompt: A square sheet is folded in half from left to right. One hole is punched near the upper-right corner of the folded rectangle. Where will the holes appear when the sheet is unfolded?

choices.C: Near the upper-left and lower-right corners

questions.explanation: Unfolding across the vertical centerline reflects the punched hole to the opposite upper corner.

questions.prompt: A rectangular sheet is folded in half from bottom to top, then in half from right to left. One hole is punched at the center of the final folded rectangle. How many holes will appear when the sheet is completely unfolded?
questions.explanation: Two perpendicular folds create four layers, so one central punch produces four reflected holes.

questions.prompt: A square sheet is folded along the diagonal from the upper-left corner to the lower-right corner. A hole is punched near the upper-right corner of the folded triangle, away from the fold. What appears after unfolding?

choices.B: Four holes, one near each corner
choices.C: Two holes near the upper-left and lower-right corners
choices.D: Two holes reflected across the diagonal, near the upper-right and lower-left corners

questions.correctAnswer: Two holes reflected across the diagonal, near the upper-right and lower-left corners
questions.explanation: The diagonal fold reflects the off-fold punch to the corresponding position across that diagonal.

questions.prompt: A square sheet is folded in half from top to bottom. A semicircular cut is made along the middle of the horizontal fold edge. What appears when the sheet is unfolded?

choices.A: One complete circular hole centered on the horizontal centerline
choices.B: Two separate semicircular cuts at the top and bottom edges
choices.C: One semicircular cut at the left edge
choices.D: Two complete circular holes beside the centerline

questions.correctAnswer: One complete circular hole centered on the horizontal centerline
questions.explanation: The semicircular cut reflects across the folded edge to form one complete circle.

questions.prompt:
Figures in the group:
1. ○ ● ○
2. □ ■ □
3. △ ▲ △
Which choice belongs in the same group?
questions.explanation: Each group member has matching open outer shapes and the filled version of that shape at the center.

questions.prompt:
Figures in the group:
1. ↑ → ↓
2. → ↓ ←
3. ↓ ← ↑
Which choice belongs in the same group?
questions.explanation: In every group member, each successive arrow rotates 90° clockwise.

questions.prompt:
Figures in the group:
1. Outer ○ | Center ■ | Outer ○
2. Outer □ | Center ▲ | Outer □
3. Outer △ | Center ◆ | Outer △
Which choice belongs in the same group?

choices.C: Outer ■ | Center ○ | Outer ■

questions.explanation: Each arrangement has identical open outer shapes surrounding one different filled center shape.

questions.prompt:
In each row, the third cell is formed by removing from the first cell every symbol that also appears in the second cell. Order is preserved.
Row 1: ○ □ △ | □ | ○ △
Row 2: ★ ◇ + | ★ + | ?
Which cell completes the matrix?
questions.explanation: Removing ★ and + from the first cell leaves only ◇ in its original position.

questions.prompt:
Consider this 2 × 2 matrix:
Top-left: Arrow ↑ outside an open circle ○
Top-right: Arrow → inside an open circle ○
Bottom-left: Arrow ← outside a filled circle ●
Bottom-right: ?
Moving right, the arrow rotates 90° clockwise and moves inside the circle. Moving down, the arrow rotates 90° counterclockwise and the circle becomes filled.
Which figure completes the matrix?

choices.C: Arrow ← inside an open circle ○

questions.explanation: Either stated transformation produces an upward arrow inside a filled circle.

questions.prompt:
Consider this 3 × 3 matrix:
Row 1: ○ | □ | △
Row 2: □ | △ | ○
Row 3: △ | ○ | ?
Every row and column contains each shape exactly once.
questions.explanation: A square completes the one-of-each-shape pattern in both the last row and last column.

questions.prompt:
In each row, the second cell is the horizontal reflection of the first. The third cell changes both reflected shapes from open to filled.
Row 1: Left ○ | Right □ ; Left □ | Right ○ ; Left ■ | Right ●
Row 2: Left △ | Right ◇ ; Left ◇ | Right △ ; ?
Which cell completes the matrix?

choices.C: Left ◆ | Right ▲

questions.explanation: Reflection places ◇ left of △, and filling them changes the pair to ◆ left of ▲.

questions.prompt: A square sheet is folded from left to right along the vertical centerline. The folded rectangle is then folded from bottom to top along its horizontal centerline. One hole is punched near the upper-right corner of the final folded square. What pattern appears when the sheet is completely unfolded?

choices.A: Four holes, one near each corner
choices.B: Two holes near the two upper corners
choices.C: Four holes centered along the four edges
choices.D: Two holes near the upper-right and lower-left corners

questions.correctAnswer: Four holes, one near each corner
questions.explanation: The two perpendicular center folds reflect the punch across both centerlines, producing four corner positions.

questions.prompt: A rectangular sheet is folded in half from top to bottom. A small triangular cut is made in the middle of the folded sheet’s left outer edge, not on the fold. What appears after the sheet is unfolded?

choices.A: One diamond opening at the center
choices.B: Four triangular openings near the corners
choices.C: Two matching triangular notches on the left edge, mirrored across the horizontal centerline
choices.D: Two notches, one on the left edge and one on the right edge

questions.correctAnswer: Two matching triangular notches on the left edge, mirrored across the horizontal centerline
questions.explanation: Unfolding reflects the outer-edge cut vertically while keeping both notches on the left boundary.

questions.prompt: A square sheet is folded along the diagonal from the upper-left corner to the lower-right corner, forming a triangular packet. The packet is folded in half by bringing its upper-left corner to its lower-right corner. One hole is punched away from all folded edges. How many holes appear when the sheet is completely unfolded?
questions.explanation: Two folds create four layers at the punch, so reversing both folds produces four symmetric holes.

questions.prompt: A rectangular sheet is folded from right to left along the vertical centerline. A semicircular cut is made at the midpoint of the folded sheet’s top outer edge, away from the vertical fold. What appears when the sheet is unfolded?

choices.A: One circular hole at the center
choices.B: Two matching semicircular notches along the top edge
choices.C: Two semicircular notches along the left edge
choices.D: Four semicircular notches, one on each edge

questions.correctAnswer: Two matching semicircular notches along the top edge
questions.explanation: The vertical fold reflects the top-edge cut to the corresponding position on the other half.

questions.prompt:
The following arrangements belong to the same group:
○ above ●
□ above ■
△ above ▲
Which arrangement belongs to the same group?

choices.C: ◇ above ◆

questions.explanation: Each valid pair places an open shape above its filled counterpart.

questions.prompt:
The following arrangements belong to the same group:
↑ ○ ↓
→ □ ←
↓ △ ↑
Which arrangement belongs to the same group?
questions.explanation: In each valid arrangement, the outer arrows point in opposite directions with an open shape between them.

questions.prompt:
The following figures belong to the same group:
Open circle ○ containing +
Open square □ containing +
Open diamond ◇ containing +
Which figure belongs to the same group?

choices.C: Open triangle △ containing ×

questions.explanation: Each valid figure is an open boundary shape containing a plus sign.

questions.prompt:
The following arrangements belong to the same group:
○ □ ○
△ ◇ △
☆ + ☆
Which arrangement belongs to the same group?
questions.explanation: Each valid arrangement has identical open outer shapes surrounding a different open center shape.

questions.prompt:
Each row follows the same rule.
Row 1: ○ | ● | ○●
Row 2: □ | ■ | □■
Row 3: △ | ▲ | ?
Which cell completes the matrix?
questions.explanation: Each third cell joins the open shape from the first cell to the filled shape from the second.

questions.prompt:
In each row, the arrow in the second cell is the first arrow rotated 90° clockwise, and the third is rotated another 90° clockwise.
Row 1: ↑ | → | ↓
Row 2: ← | ↑ | →
Row 3: ↓ | ← | ?
Which arrow completes the matrix?
questions.explanation: Rotating ↓ clockwise gives ←, and rotating ← clockwise gives ↑.

questions.prompt:
In each row, the third cell contains the shape appearing in both of the first two cells.
Row 1: ○□ | □△ | □
Row 2: △◇ | ○△ | △
Row 3: ☆○ | ◇☆ | ?
Which cell completes the matrix?
questions.explanation: The star is the only shape shared by the first two cells in the third row.

questions.prompt:
The filled shape moves one corner clockwise in each cell.
Cell 1: Top-left ●; other corners ○
Cell 2: Top-right ●; other corners ○
Cell 3: Bottom-right ●; other corners ○
What is Cell 4?

choices.C: Bottom-right ●; other corners ○

questions.explanation: The filled circle moves clockwise from top-left to top-right to bottom-right and then bottom-left.

questions.prompt:
Each row changes the first cell by exchanging open and filled forms while keeping the shapes and order unchanged.
Row 1: ○■ | ●□
Row 2: △◆ | ▲◇
Row 3: □★ | ?
Which cell completes the matrix?
questions.explanation: Changing □ from open to filled gives ■, while changing ★ from filled to open gives ☆.

questions.prompt: A square sheet is folded from bottom to top along the horizontal centerline. It is then folded along the diagonal of the folded rectangle from its lower-left corner to its upper-right corner. One hole is punched away from every edge and fold. How many holes appear after complete unfolding?
questions.explanation: Two independent folds create four layers, so one punch away from folds produces four reflected holes.

questions.prompt: A rectangular sheet is folded from left to right along the vertical centerline. Two holes are punched, one near the top outer edge and one near the bottom outer edge, at different distances from the vertical fold. What appears after unfolding?

choices.A: Two holes on the right half only
choices.B: Two holes aligned on the vertical centerline
choices.C: Four holes forming two left-right mirror pairs
choices.D: Eight holes forming four mirror pairs

questions.correctAnswer: Four holes forming two left-right mirror pairs
questions.explanation: Each of the two punches reflects once across the vertical fold, producing two distinct mirrored pairs.

questions.prompt: A square sheet is folded along the diagonal from the upper-right corner to the lower-left corner. A triangular cut is made in the middle of the diagonal folded edge. What appears when the sheet is unfolded?

choices.A: One triangular notch on an outside edge
choices.B: Two separate triangular holes away from the diagonal
choices.C: Four triangular holes around the center
choices.D: One diamond-shaped hole centered on the diagonal

questions.correctAnswer: One diamond-shaped hole centered on the diagonal
questions.explanation: A triangular cut on the folded diagonal reflects across that fold to form one diamond-shaped opening.

questions.prompt: A square sheet is folded in half from right to left and then folded again from top to bottom. A small cut is made at the corner of the final folded square where the two folded edges meet. What appears after complete unfolding?

choices.A: Four matching corner cuts, one at each corner of the original sheet
choices.B: One cut at the center of the original sheet
choices.C: Two cuts along the top edge only

questions.correctAnswer: One cut at the center of the original sheet
questions.explanation: The described packet corner lies at the intersection of both folds, so unfolding leaves one central cut.

questions.prompt:
Figures in the group:
1. ○ inside □
2. △ inside ◇
3. ☆ inside ○
In every figure, the inner shape has fewer straight sides than the outer shape.
Which figure belongs to the same group?

choices.C: ◇ inside ○

questions.explanation: The inner circle has no straight sides, fewer than the outer triangle’s three sides.

questions.prompt:
Arrangements in the group:
1. ○ ● ○
2. □ ■ □
3. △ ▲ △
Each arrangement has matching open shapes on the outside and the filled form of that shape in the center.
Which arrangement belongs to the same group?
questions.explanation: The two outside shapes are matching open diamonds, and the center is the filled form of the diamond.

questions.prompt:
Figures in the group:
1. Top: ↑; Bottom: ↓
2. Left: ←; Right: →
3. Upper-left: ↖ is not used; instead, Top-left: ← and Bottom-right: →
For all three figures, the two arrows point away from the center along the line joining them. Which choice belongs to the same group?

choices.C: Top: ↑; Bottom: ↑

questions.explanation: Both arrows point away from the center along the horizontal line joining their positions.

questions.prompt:
Arrangements in the group:
1. ○ | □□ | △△△
2. ◇ | ○○ | ☆☆☆
3. □ | △△ | ◇◇◇
Each arrangement increases from one symbol to two matching symbols to three matching symbols, using a different shape in each position.
Which arrangement belongs to the same group?
questions.explanation: The counts increase from one to three, and each position uses a different shape.

questions.prompt:
In each row, the third cell contains the symbols that appear in exactly one of the first two cells.
Row 1: ○ + | + □ | ○ □
Row 2: △ ☆ | ☆ ◆ | △ ◆
Row 3: ◇ ■ | ■ ● | ?
Which cell completes the matrix?
questions.explanation: Symbols appearing in both cells cancel, leaving the diamond from the first cell and circle from the second.

questions.prompt:
Each cell contains one arrow above one shape.
Top-left: ↑ above ○
Top-right: → above ●
Bottom-left: ← above ●
Bottom-right: ?
Across each row, the arrow rotates 90° clockwise and the shape changes from open to filled or filled to open. Which completes the matrix?

choices.C: ↓ above ●

questions.explanation: Moving right rotates the arrow clockwise and switches the shape’s fill in both rows.

questions.prompt:
The position of a star moves one corner clockwise in each cell, while its form alternates open and filled.
Cell 1: top-left ☆
Cell 2: top-right ★
Cell 3: bottom-right ☆
Cell 4: ?
Which is Cell 4?

choices.C: bottom-left ☆

questions.explanation: The star moves clockwise through the corners while alternating open, filled, open, filled.

questions.prompt:
In each row, the third cell is formed by reversing the order of the first cell and then changing each shape from open to filled.
Row 1: ○ △ | △ ○ | ▲ ●
Row 2: □ ◇ | ◇ □ | ◆ ■
Row 3: ☆ ○ | ○ ☆ | ?
Which cell completes Row 3?
questions.explanation: Reversing ☆ ○ gives ○ ☆, and filling both shapes produces ● ★.

questions.prompt: A square sheet is folded along the diagonal from upper-left to lower-right. A circular hole is punched near the upper-right corner of the folded triangle, away from the fold. What appears after the sheet is unfolded?

choices.A: One hole near the upper-right corner
choices.B: Four holes, one near each corner
choices.C: Two holes near the upper-left and lower-right corners
choices.D: Two holes reflected across the diagonal, near the upper-right and lower-left corners

questions.correctAnswer: Two holes reflected across the diagonal, near the upper-right and lower-left corners
questions.explanation: Unfolding reflects the off-fold punch across the named diagonal.

questions.prompt: A rectangular sheet is folded from left to right along its vertical centerline. It is then folded from bottom to top along its horizontal centerline. A small triangular cut is made at the folded packet’s outer upper-right corner. What appears after unfolding?

choices.A: One triangular cut at the center
choices.B: Four matching corner cuts, one at each corner
choices.C: Two cuts along the right edge

questions.correctAnswer: Four matching corner cuts, one at each corner
questions.explanation: Two center folds bring all four original corners together, so the cut reflects to every corner.

questions.prompt: A square sheet is folded from top to bottom along the horizontal centerline. A semicircular notch is cut from the folded edge, left of center. What appears after unfolding?

choices.A: One complete circular hole left of center on the horizontal centerline
choices.B: Two semicircular notches on the top edge
choices.C: Two complete holes mirrored left and right
choices.D: One semicircular notch on the bottom edge

questions.correctAnswer: One complete circular hole left of center on the horizontal centerline
questions.explanation: The semicircular notch lies on the fold and reflects into its matching half when unfolded.

questions.prompt: A rectangular sheet is folded from right to left along the vertical centerline. Two holes are punched in the folded sheet: one near the upper-left corner and one near the lower-left corner, both away from the fold. What appears after unfolding?

choices.A: Two holes along the left edge
choices.B: Four holes in one horizontal row
choices.C: Two holes near the upper corners only
choices.D: Four holes, forming upper and lower pairs reflected across the vertical centerline

questions.correctAnswer: Four holes, forming upper and lower pairs reflected across the vertical centerline
questions.explanation: Each of the two punches reflects once across the vertical fold, producing four holes.

questions.prompt:
These arrangements share one rule:
○ | ●●
□ | ■■
△ | ▲▲
Which arrangement follows the same rule?
questions.explanation: Each arrangement pairs one open shape with two filled versions of the same shape.

questions.prompt:
These arrangements share one rule:
→ ○ ←
→ □ ←
→ △ ←
Which arrangement follows the same rule?
questions.explanation: In each valid arrangement, the two arrows point inward toward the central open shape.

questions.prompt:
These figures share one rule:
Outer □ containing inner ○
Outer △ containing inner □
Outer ◇ containing inner △
The inner shape of each figure is the outer shape of the preceding figure. Which figure can come next?

choices.C: Outer ○ containing inner ○

questions.explanation: The inner shape must match the previous figure’s outer diamond, while the new outer shape changes.

questions.prompt:
These arrangements share one rule:
Top: ○ | Center: + | Bottom: ○
Top: □ | Center: × | Bottom: □
Top: △ | Center: - | Bottom: △
Which arrangement follows the same rule?

choices.C: Top: ◇ | Center: | | Bottom: ◇

questions.explanation: Each valid arrangement has identical open shapes above and below a different line symbol.

questions.prompt:
These sequences share one rule:
○ ● ○ ●
□ ■ □ ■
△ ▲ △ ▲
Which sequence follows the same rule?
questions.explanation: The sequence alternates the open and filled versions of one shape, beginning with the open form.
